subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class VIII

source.read: NCERT, Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage (2017), English section, read through a copy hosted by the Indian Education Repository (CPR India); CBSE circular 05/2019 asks schools to use it; Class VIII list
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A copy of the NCERT document, read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The class books have since changed (Mridang for Classes 1-2, Santoor for 3-5, Poorvi for 6-8, under NCF-SE 2023); their chapters are not listed here and a school may order or extend these outcomes.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Follows instructions and announcements in school and public places.
outcomes.note: Questions on passages heard are practised; real announcements are not.

outcomes.text: Introduces guests and interviews people about their work.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Uses polite phrases to make requests and to disagree.
outcomes.note: Formal and polite wording is practised in sentences; saying it aloud is not heard.

outcomes.text: Gives a short prepared speech, for example in the school assembly.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Narrates real and imagined stories and experiences.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads for details, characters, the main idea and order, and relates ideas to life.
Explains quotations, sayings and proverbs.
Reads photographs, sketches, tables, charts and maps, and uses them in writing.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Works out the meaning of new words from context.
Uses a dictionary, thesaurus and encyclopaedia for meaning in context.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Reads for pleasure and writes a book review.
outcomes.note: The suggested books are published works and are not in the app. The learner reads one and tells a grown-up about it; the app's own stories are in Reading.

outcomes.text: Writes from dictation with correct spelling and punctuation.
Drafts, revises, edits and finishes coherent paragraphs.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes emails, notices, formal letters, diary entries and reports.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes descriptions, narratives and life stories.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes a piece after gathering information from print and online sources.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Turns a story into a skit, and a dialogue into a story.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses active and passive voice, reported speech and tenses in context.
Uses clauses and comparing adjectives accurately.
Notices punctuation in texts and uses it when editing own writing.
